TUNI Luottamuksellinen - Confidential (3Y)

We have positions open for Postdoctoral Research Fellows (2-4 years) and Doctoral Researchers (4 years) to join us in the Research Centre of Gameful Realities at Tampere University, Finland!

The positions are broadly situated at the intersection of HCI, games and gamification, XR/VR, GenAI, bioadaptive technologies, and emerging interactive technologies, with a focus on prosocial, sustainable, and transformative applications.

Applicants can develop their own research agenda within one or both of two broader directions:

OPEN – Engaging Media and Technologies for Sustainable Applications Research may address topics such as interaction and user experience, motivation and behaviour, learning, participation and agency, social connection and cooperation, wellbeing, perspective-taking, creativity, systems thinking, public engagement with science, AI-mediated interaction, and transformative experiences.

CLIMETA – VR, Metacognition, and Climate Change Engagement CLIMETA investigates how immersive VR and related technologies can support people's capacity to reflect on and regulate their cognitive, emotional, and behavioural engagement with complex societal challenges such as climate change.

Postdoctoral Research Fellows, 1–3 positions

Doctoral Researchers, 1–3 positions

Relevant backgrounds include HCI, computer science, affective computing, information systems, cognitive science and psychology, interaction/game design, media and communication, behavioural sciences, education, health technology, economics, and human-environment interaction.
